svg.title: Structuring the workflow
svg.desc: How are stages, responsibilities and continuity arranged? Separate progression through work, allocation of actions and authority, and continuity across interruptions or handoffs. Source illustration: Stage criteria and a controller decision determine whether the creative problem-solving workflow advances.

text.tspan: How are stages, responsibilities and continuity
Organises work into stages, loops, roles and decision points, with
ways to coordinate actions, hand work over, recover from problems
